subject: prd/argus-unattended-drive
statement: If a wake signal is lost, then a bounded, stated-cost backstop shall deliver the awaited completion at its next tick, so that no open drive awaits an occurred completion indefinitely.
rationale: push triggers with the polling backstop (vision §11); no lost drives
fit_criterion: suppressed-signal drill: the backstop resumes the drive within one configured interval; the backstop's steady-state cost is stated and ~0 when nothing is awaited (UB-7)
